item.title: Family and Consumer Connection Group — Tue Sep 1, 3:00 PM — Virtual
item.description:
Family and Consumer Connection Group: A professionally facilitated group where families and consumers come together to discuss and problem-solve challenges in a supportive environment. Goals of the group include providing support, improving communication, and strengthening socialization. This group meets on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday of the month from 3:00pm to 4:15pm Participation requires an orientation process. If you wish to participate in The Family and Consumer Connection group, please reach out to Eileen Strungis at (973) 509-9777, x 123, or email her at estrungis@mhainspire.org
Source: MHA of Essex and Morris
